svg.title: Modular addition learning curves for ten seeds
svg.desc: Modular addition modulo 59, training fraction .4. All ten seeds reach training accuracy 99% at step 500, but none reaches held-out accuracy 99% by 300000 steps. All logged positive-step observations are joined without smoothing on a logarithmic step axis; step 0 is outside that axis. Training and held-out curves use distinct line styles. Seeds 5 and 8 are highlighted for readability, not as separate experimental arms.
svg.metadata: CC BY 4.0. Compact redraw; recorded values unchanged. Original figure metadata retained.
